Priya (partnerships): Heads up — EdgeScale reported an offline ledger replay that resulted in duplicated entitlements for customer ACME. Partner retried the batch after a transient S3 error. Example payload they sent:
```json
{
  "customer_id": "ACME",
  "entitlement_id": "ES-ENT-9876",
  "units": 100,
  "batch_id": "20260319-1430",
  "idempotency_key": "edge-ACME-20260319-1430"
}
```
Anyone seen this exact pattern before?

Sam (billing): Do we persist partner idempotency_key today or only our ingest_event_id? If partner changed the key on retry we'd treat it as a new event.

Mike (eng): We currently store whatever they send in raw_events.payload but dedupe uses ingest_event_id. Can you paste the raw rows? Quick check I asked: `SELECT * FROM marketplace_events WHERE batch_id='20260319-1430' AND customer_id='ACME';`

Anika (integrations): Partners are supposed to keep idempotency_key stable. If they don't, we need a reconciliation/dedupe layer keyed on (customer_id, entitlement_id, billing_period). Proposal: run a reconciliation job that groups by billing_period and collapses duplicates, then emit a correction delta.

Jared (sre): +1 on reconciliation, but be careful with backfills — running an update that modifies already-set credits will ripple to billing downstream. Backfill must: 1) produce audit CSV, 2) write correction events (not mutate historic invoice rows), 3) run in low-traffic window.

Priya (partnerships): Action items: 1) Mike to add ingest-side dedupe to check `idempotency_key` and ignore duplicates if seen in last 30 days (ETA: today EOD) 2) Anika to run recon query and upload CSV of affected customers (ETA: tomorrow AM) 3) Sam to hold crediting for flagged customers until recon is validated. @Mike @Anika @Sam

Mike (eng): I'll push a small patch to read idempotency_key from payload and early-return on duplicates. Will add a short TTL (30d) to avoid unbounded state. PR: https://git.internal/marketplace/ingest/pulls/412 :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: deploy pipeline started for service marketplace-ingest v1.42.2 — job 7821 kicked off

Anika (integrations): Reconciliation query I'm running (posting here so it's reproducible):
```sql
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT customer_id, entitlement_id, billing_period, units, event_ts,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, entitlement_id, billing_period ORDER BY event_ts DESC) rn
  FROM marketplace_credits
  WHERE source = 'edgescale' AND event_ts >= '2026-03-01'
)
SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn > 1;
```
Running it now and will upload the CSV to the partner ticket.

Sam (billing): Thanks. Hold credits for any customers in the CSV until we confirm correction events. Also add a feature-flag `edgescale.replay_dedupe` so we can toggle behavior per partner.

Priya (partnerships): Will coordinate customer comms once Anika has the list. Also opening a short partner-contract ticket asking EdgeScale to preserve idempotency_key on retries and to include a stable batch_uuid.

Anika (integrations): Uploaded report to the partner ticket and flagged the top 3 customers with the largest duplicated units. I'll follow up with a CSV and recommended correction events.

Mike (eng): After the ingest patch, I'll run a dry-run of the recon script to generate correction events (no writes). Sharing dry-run output in the next thread.

Jared (sre): Reminder: label any correction events with `correction=true` and add an audit record so downstream billing can reconcile.

Priya (partnerships): Excellent. Thanks team — looping in EdgeScale PM in the partner ticket for a process fix.
